title: Stella Stars
summary: A poster that shows how one elite school rewards and punishes its students, drawn as a night sky.
coverAlt: Poster of a night sky where every star and bolt marks one award

blocks.heading: The brief
blocks.body: Collect a real system of rules and make it understandable at a glance.

blocks.heading: The idea
blocks.body: Eden Academy gives Stella stars for excellence and Tonitrus bolts for bad behavior. Eight stars make an Imperial Scholar, and eight bolts mean expulsion. A sky was the natural form. Stars rise, bolts strike, and every student becomes a constellation.

blocks.label: Raw data. The table of awards by class and term.
Rejected directions. A bar chart and a ladder, with a note on why both felt too cold.

blocks.caption: Up close, each mark carries the student’s class and term.

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: The sky made the system look fair and beautiful, which it is not. The final version adds one quiet line of text that says so.
